title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: replacement set for lost originals by document type
content:
## Scope

When originals are lost, a replacement set may be issued on certain Bills of Lading and Transport Documents types. This reference lists, per type, whether a replacement set is available, the calendar days after the loss report before it may be issued, the bank guarantee required for it as a percentage of the declared cargo value, and the fee per replacement set.

## Tier table

| Document type | Replacement set for lost originals available | Waiting period after the loss report (calendar days) | Bank guarantee (percent of declared cargo value) | Fee per replacement set |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | 0 | 0 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Yes | 7 | 150 | USD 250.00 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 | 200 | USD 350.00 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | 14 | 200 | USD 350.00 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | No | 0 | 0 | USD 0.00 |

## Reading the table

- A replacement set is available only on the AHL Straight, AHL Negotiable and AHL Combined Transport Bills of Lading; on the other types every value in the row is 0.
- The AHL Straight Bill of Lading has the shorter wait (7 days) and the lower guarantee (150 percent).

## Hypothetical guarantee illustrations

The declared cargo values here are hypothetical inputs, not customer facts.

- AHL Straight Bill of Lading, declared cargo value USD 20,000.00: USD 20,000.00 multiplied by 150 percent gives a bank guarantee of USD 30,000.00.
- AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading, declared cargo value USD 31,250.40: USD 31,250.40 multiplied by 200 percent gives a bank guarantee of USD 62,500.80.

## Points of judgement

**What does a replacement set cost on an AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading?** USD 350.00 per replacement set, with a 14-day wait after the loss report.

**Is a replacement set possible for an AHL Switch Bill of Lading?** No; the setting is No.
